details: This project developed streamline the checkout experience and online payment processing so
customers can easily and safely pay how they want and wherever they are. Customers can use a wide
array of payment options, including credit and debit card processing, mobile payments, and online
payment gateways. Offers advanced fraud protection, data security, and insightful analytics to help
businesses optimize their payment processes and enhance customer experiences. By integrating
innovative technology and comprehensive support, this project aims to simplify and streamline
transactions, driving growth and efficiency for its clients across various industries.
• Implemented the Backend API using Restful Web Services.

projects.name: B2BBridge
details: Environment/Tools: Java / J2EE, Spring Boot, Restful web services, ReactsJs, Microservices,Kafka,
MongoDB, Reactjs Hibernate ,Tomcat.
Description:
B2BBridge is a centralized booking and tracking system with an automated dispatching and
handling mechanism. Multiple Cab Agencies can connect and handle their bookings with their
software. It provides some feature like intercity bookings, Airport bookings, Outstation bookings, Cab
for Bus Bookings, Public shared taxi (PST) and Posting bookings, Posting Vehicles to other Cab
agencies with their mutual understanding. 3rd party APIs for map and SMS are used in this project.
